title.zh: David Sacks：前沿AI企业签署《超级智能白宫协议》，并实施新的内部控制和外部审计机制
title.en: David Sacks：前沿AI企业签署《超级智能白宫协议》，并实施新的内部控制和外部审计机制

current_state.zh: Frontier AI lab leaders signed a White House 'Superintelligence Agreement' pledging safe development practices, new internal controls, and external audits, a voluntary governance framework Sacks framed as an alternative to stalled international accords.
current_state.en: Frontier AI lab leaders signed a White House 'Superintelligence Agreement' pledging safe development practices, new internal controls, and external audits, a voluntary governance framework Sacks framed as an alternative to stalled international accords.
